A few guys choose keep the money and sleep in their cars, or take a long commute home every night if it's 2 hours or less. I called the project manager and said I'd go if he increased the per-diem enough to pay for a single room. He said yes. My male coworkers are now mad that I 'asked for special treatment' and shared rooms are 'just how things are done in this industry'. I feel that if they wanted their own rooms, no one has ever stopped them from asking. AITA?
